summary: Practise accessible hazard messages, audience assessment and feedback planning. Explore the five-day risk communication course and its applied exercises.
lede: Risk communication for vulnerable populations turns hazard information into messages people can access, understand and act on despite communication barriers. It is designed for practitioners and team leads responsible for public information, community engagement or emergency communication. Participants assess audience barriers, create segmented and accessible message maps, select suitable channels, and plan feedback and rumor-response processes with attention to safeguarding.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who plan, deliver or evaluate risk messages and community feedback for people facing access, communication or safeguarding barriers.
modules: WHO RCCE Principles and Risk Context
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public information, community engagement or emergency communication is expected. No coding or programming is required.
